messages:
mina: Quick check — streaming chat/completions behaviour: do we guarantee a final 'delta' with an explicit final flag (e.g. "final": true) for function/tool calls? Some client UIs rely on that to flush and call callbacks. :thinking:
alex: Short answer: hosted/runtime currently emits final:true for the last delta, but older Dedicated/Private agents sometimes emit a terminal event string instead ("event": "end"). cc @sam
sam: For clarity, current streaming shape we ship is roughly:
```
{
  "type": "delta",
  "role": "tool",
  "chunk": "{\"foo\":\"bar\"}",
  "final": false
}
...
{
  "type": "delta",
  "final": true,
  "meta": { "func_call": "completed" }
}
```
Clients should treat `final: true` as end-of-call and assemble partials into full args.
alex: Old agent (pre-v2 runtime) used: `{type: "event", event: "end"}` as the terminal marker instead of final flag, so some SDKs expecting that will break.
jordan: So is that a breaking change for customers on older SDKs? We have at least two customers using bespoke SDKs that look for event=="end".
alex: Plan: add a temporary compatibility shim that emits both the `final: true` delta and an additional terminal `event: "end"` message when the request includes `x-rw-stream-compat: 1`. Keep shim enabled for ~90 days then remove. No other behavioral changes.
sam: I'll add test vectors and an integration case to validate assembly of `partial_args` into final `arguments` object. Pseudo-server flow:
```
emit({type: "delta", chunk: "...", final: false})
...
emit({type: "delta", chunk: "", final: true})
if (compat) emit({type: "event", event: "end"})
```
Note: keep `name` as a string, stream `partial_args` as chunks, then send final structured `arguments` when final:true.
mina: Got it. One more thing — toolcall params: should clients expect `arguments` always as string until final, or can we stream JSON objects?
alex: Keep it simple: stream as text chunks (partial_args) and provide full parsed `arguments` object in the final delta. That avoids mid-stream parsing edgecases. We'll document this in the API contract.
jordan: I'll update the contract doc and add a migration note in CHANGELOG and the SDK repo links.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary to eng-platform at 1746000035 — rollout=canary, pr=fix/streaming-shim, affected=streaming-shim
mina: Thanks y'all. Quick and clean. :thumbsup:
alex: Filing a tiny PR for the shim + tests, assigning to @sam for review. Ping if any customers report regressions.
